name: TwIL-LM
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes:
ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.711 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-07-23.

CAVEAT: the win is IN-DOMAIN. Every recorded row comes from the card's Track A formal-logic suite (200 prompts per objective, greedy, 2048 tokens), where the model beats its base on all six objective lanes. On the card's own Track B held-out general table it is slightly BELOW base (macro-14 0.3742 vs 0.3838) - the card says as much and recommends its larger sibling TwIL-LM3 for held-out retention. TwIL-LM3 is already a separate record (data/models/twil-lm3.json); this is its 1.7B predecessor from SmolLM2, not a repack of it. 

Also note the card's own footnote: the base column's macro-gate cell (0.2590) comes from an external-comparison run rather than the paired run, a run-to-run artefact on the same checkpoint. The paired run is the basis used here.
